aliasNotes.Apache Software License: A classifier, which names no version. The one package that reaches it today, python-dateutil 2.9.0.post0, says Apache License, Version 2.0 in its LICENSE (read Oct 31). Read the licence of any other package that reaches it.
aliasNotes.BSD License: A classifier, which names no clause count. The one package that reaches it today, python-dateutil 2.9.0.post0, carries the 3-Clause licence in its LICENSE, for all of its code (read Oct 31). Read the licence of any other package that reaches it.
aliasNotes.Dual License: Not an alias: python-dateutil's License field. licences_py.py reads such a package's licences from its classifiers instead.
